auth.signIn.adminLede: Single sign-on is required for {workspace}. Only admins kept as a fallback can use a password.
auth.signIn.deactivatedBody: An admin turned it off, so signing in here won’t work. Ask a {workspace} admin to turn it back on in Settings › People.
auth.signIn.down: Your connection is fine; the server isn’t answering.
auth.signIn.expiredBody: For security, sessions end after a while or when an admin signs you out. Sign in to go back to where you were; everything you saved is still there.
auth.signIn.rateLimitedBody: To keep it safe, sign-in is paused for {wait}. Waiting does not lock you out. <link>Reset your password</link> if you’ve forgotten it.
auth.signIn.rateLimitedTitle: Too many attempts for this account
auth.signIn.retrying: Nothing you typed is lost. We’ll try again on our own in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
auth.signIn.signedOutBody: You signed out of {workspace} on this browser.
auth.signIn.slow: Taking longer than usual… still trying.
auth.signIn.ssoRequiredBody: {workspace} signs people in through its identity provider. Only admins kept as a fallback can use a password.
auth.signIn.tellAdmin: If it lasts, tell whoever runs Bemmoly at {workspace}.
auth.signIn.timeout: The server took too long to answer.
auth.signIn.title: Sign in
